# Reverse Engineering Network & Architecture Report: cinejoy.pk

**Investigator**: explorer_survey_2  
**Date**: November 4, 2026  
**Target Application**: cinejoy.pk  
**Target Platform**: LG webOS TV (webOS 8.5.0, SDK 8.5.0, LG 32LR686BPSA)  
**Status**: Completed & Verified End-to-End

---

## Executive Summary

`cinejoy.pk` is a single-page application (SPA) built on **SvelteKit** (using `@sveltejs/kit` with static client-side hydration) protected at the edge by **DDOS-Guard**. The website does **not** rely on server-side HTML rendering (SSR) for catalog content, nor does it have a proprietary monolithic backend for catalog metadata. Instead, the architecture is a **decoupled, multi-service streaming client** that coordinates:

1. **The Movie Database (TMDB) API v3**: Directly queried from the client using public API key `8476a7ab80ad76f0936744df0430e67c` for all catalog browsing, trending/top-rated carousels, genre/year/provider filtering, multi-search, cast/credits, posters/backdrops, and season/episode metadata.
2. **Wing Lists API (`lists.wing.st`)**: Provides curated editorial lists (Oscar Nominees, Cannes, Halloween, Rotten Tomatoes Best of All Time, Mindfuck Movies, True Story) with full item metadata and cross-platform rating aggregations (IMDB, Letterboxd, Metacritic, Rotten Tomatoes, RogerEbert).
3. **Wing Community/Social Server (`server.wing.st`)**: REST endpoints for community user lists search, title upvotes, and comments.
4. **Wing Subtitles API (`subs.wing.st`)**: Multi-lingual subtitle discovery endpoint supporting 280+ SRT subtitle streams per title, backed by MovieBox/Chuaxin steganographic storage.
5. **TheIntroDB API (`api.theintrodb.org`)**: Precision crowd-sourced intro and end-credits timestamp database for automatic intro/credit skipping.
6. **Wing Stream Resolver & Cipher Gateway (`api.wing.st`)**: A proprietary cryptographic gateway utilizing a custom WebAssembly binary (`crush.wasm`, protocol codename `lumen-gate-v2`) and AES-256-GCM encryption over an unformatted binary HTTP POST endpoint (`/g`).
7. **Lightspeed CDN (`lightspeed.st`)**: High-throughput Cloudflare-fronted HLS video distribution network delivering multi-bitrate fragmented MP4 streams (360p, 720p, 1080p, 4K 2160p HDR PQ) with independent English 5.1/stereo audio tracks disguised as steganographic `.png` chunks (`init.png`, `seg-v*.png`).

---

## 1. Network Traffic & Endpoints Inventory

| Service / Endpoint | Method | Role | CORS Header (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin`) | Origin/Referer Enforcement |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `https://cinejoy.pk/` | GET | SPA HTML Shell (SvelteKit) | `<none>` (DDOS-Guard protected) | None |
| `https://api.themoviedb.org/3/*` | GET | Metadata, Catalog, Search, Providers | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/*` | GET | Posters, Backdrops, Logos | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://lists.wing.st/joy` | GET | Editorial Collections Index | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://lists.wing.st/joy/:slug` | GET | Editorial Collection Items | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://server.wing.st/api/lists/public/search` | GET | User List Search by TMDB IDs | Enforces `https://cinejoy.pk` | **Strict**: 403 on `file://` or custom origin |
| `https://server.wing.st/api/votes/:type/:id` | GET/POST | Upvote Counts & Voting | Enforces `https://cinejoy.pk` | **Strict**: 403 on `file://` or custom origin |
| `https://server.wing.st/api/comments/:type/:id` | GET/POST | Title Comments | Enforces `https://cinejoy.pk` | **Strict**: 403 on `file://` or custom origin |
| `https://subs.wing.st/subtitles` | GET | External Subtitles Index | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://subs.wing.st/sub/:base64` | GET | Subtitle file proxy (.srt) | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://api.theintrodb.org/v2/media` | GET | Intro/Credits Skip Timestamps | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://api.wing.st/servers` | GET | Active Stream Cluster Nodes | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://api.wing.st/crush.wasm` | GET | Request Sealing WebAssembly Binary | `*` (Wildcard) | None |
| `https://api.wing.st/g` | POST | Binary Stream Resolver Gateway | `*` (Wildcard, preflight 204) | Accepts raw binary, returns encrypted binary |
| `https://lightspeed.st/hls/*` | GET | Master & Variant Playlists (.m3u8) | `*` (When Origin matches) | **CRITICAL**: Returns **HTTP 404** unless `Origin: https://cinejoy.pk` |
| `https://lightspeed.st/hls/*/*.png` | GET | fMP4 Initialization & Video Segments | `*` (When Origin matches) | **CRITICAL**: Returns **HTTP 404** unless `Origin: https://cinejoy.pk` |

---

## 2. Backend & Frontend Architecture

### 2.1 Frontend Framework & Hydration
- **Framework**: **SvelteKit** client-side single page application (`adapter-static` bundle structure under `/_app/immutable/`).
- **Hydration Marker**: `<div style="display: contents">` running `__sveltekit_c82yie = { base: "" }` and dynamic imports of `start.Cb-AOP25.js` and `app.BG_KW6jq.js`.
- **Preload Strategy**: `<body data-sveltekit-preload-data="hover">`.
- **Edge Security**: Behind DDOS-Guard reverse proxy (`server: ddos-guard`, cookies `__ddg1_`, `__ddg8_`, `__ddg9_`, `__ddg10_`).

### 2.2 Data Fetching Paradigm
- The application executes **direct client-side API orchestration**.
- When a user navigates routes, SvelteKit components fetch JSON payloads directly from TMDB and Wing APIs using browser `fetch()`.
- State caching is maintained via browser `localStorage` and `sessionStorage` (e.g., `local:Cinejoy::Progress` for playback tracking, `local:cinejoy_settings` for configuration).

---

## 3. Catalog Taxonomy & Query Mechanics

All catalog taxonomy is directly derived from TMDB API v3 endpoints using API key `8476a7ab80ad76f0936744df0430e67c`.

### 3.1 Taxonomy Matrix

| Category | Page URL | TMDB API Endpoint | Query Parameters |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Home Hero Carousel** | `/` | `/3/trending/movie/day` | `language=en-US&include_adult=false` |
| **Trending Movies** | `/category/movie/trending` | `/3/trending/movie/day` | `language=en-US&page=:page&include_adult=false` |
| **Trending TV Shows** | `/category/tv/trending` | `/3/trending/tv/day` | `language=en-US&page=:page&include_adult=false` |
| **Top Rated Movies** | `/category/movie/top_rated` | `/3/movie/top_rated` | `language=en-US&page=:page&include_adult=false` |
| **Top Rated TV Shows** | `/category/tv/top_rated` | `/3/tv/top_rated` | `language=en-US&page=:page&include_adult=false` |
| **Movies Hub** | `/movies` | `/3/discover/movie` | `sort_by=popularity.desc&watch_region=US&page=:page` |
| **TV Shows Hub** | `/series` | `/3/discover/tv` | `sort_by=popularity.desc&watch_region=US&page=:page` |
| **Streaming Providers** | `/provider/:provider_id` | `/3/discover/movie` & `/discover/tv` | `with_watch_providers=:id&watch_region=US&sort_by=popularity.desc&page=:page` |
| **Genre Filtering** | `/movies?genre=:id` | `/3/discover/movie` | `with_genres=:genre_id&sort_by=popularity.desc&page=:page` |
| **Year Filtering** | `/movies?year=:year` | `/3/discover/movie` | `primary_release_year=:year&sort_by=popularity.desc&page=:page` |
| **Country Filtering** | `/movies?country=:code` | `/3/discover/movie` | `with_origin_country=:code&sort_by=popularity.desc&page=:page` |
| **Editorial Collections** | `/` | `https://lists.wing.st/joy` | None (Returns 7 curated collections) |
| **Collection Items** | `/` | `https://lists.wing.st/joy/:slug` | `limit=25` |

### 3.2 Popular Streaming Providers Identified
- `provider/8`: Netflix
- `provider/9`: Amazon Prime Video
- `provider/337`: Disney+
- `provider/350`: Apple TV+
- `provider/2`: Apple TV (iTunes)

- `provider/1899`: HBO Max

- `provider/300`: Pluto TV

---

## 4. Pagination Mechanics

### 4.1 Discovery & Category Feeds
- **Parameter**: `&page=N` (1-indexed integer).
- **Page Size**: Standard TMDB page size of 20 items per request.
- **Trigger**: Client-side infinite scroll using an `IntersectionObserver` or scroll height listener (`window.scrollY + window.innerHeight >= document.body.scrollHeight - threshold`).
- **Response Structure**:
  ```json
  {
    "page": 1,
    "results": [ ... ],
    "total_pages": 500,
    "total_results": 10000
  }
  ```
- **Boundary Handling**: Pagination halts when `page >= total_pages`.

### 4.2 Editorial Collections (`lists.wing.st`)
- **Parameter**: `?limit=N` and `?offset=N`.
- **Response Structure**:
  ```json
  {
    "pagination": {
      "offset": 0,
      "limit": 25,
      "returned": 25,
      "total": 624,
      "complete": false
    },
    "items": [ ... ]
  }
  ```

---

## 5. Search Architecture & Mechanics

Search operates in a dual-phase hybrid model when triggered by user input on `/search`:

### 5.1 Primary Multi-Search (TMDB)
- **Endpoint**: `GET https://api.themoviedb.org/3/search/multi`
- **Query Parameters**:
  - `query`: Search string (e.g. `Inception`)
  - `language`: `en-US`
  - `page`: `1`
  - `include_adult`: `false`
  - `api_key`: `8476a7ab80ad76f0936744df0430e67c`
- **Debounce**: 300ms on typing.
- **Payload**: Heterogeneous array of items where `media_type` is `"movie"`, `"tv"`, or `"person"`.
- **Filtering**: Items without `poster_path` or obscure foreign unreleased titles are de-prioritized.

### 5.2 Secondary Community Lists Search (`server.wing.st`)
- **Endpoint**: `GET https://server.wing.st/api/lists/public/search`
- **Query Parameters**:
  - `q`: Search string
  - `tmdbIds`: Comma-separated list of top matching TMDB IDs extracted from the primary TMDB search response (e.g. `27205,542438,64956,...`).
- **Response Format**: JSON array of user-curated public watchlists containing the queried titles.

---

## 6. End-to-End Cryptographic Stream Resolution Protocol

The core streaming resolver does not use plain REST URLs. It implements a hardened protocol dubbed **Lumen Gate v2 (`lumen-gate-v2`)**.

```
[TV App Client / Local Proxy]
       │
       ├─ 1. GET https://api.wing.st/servers ──────────────────────► Returns server nodes: ["secret", "Nebula", "Lisbon", "Solara", "Athens"]
       ├─ 2. GET https://api.wing.st/crush.wasm ────────────────────► Loads standalone WebAssembly cipher binary
       │
       ├─ 3. Local WebAssembly Request Sealing:
       │     a. Generate 44 CSPRNG random bytes (ZW = 44)
       │     b. JSON payload = { path: "/${server}/${movie|series}", payload: { tmdb: id [, season, episode] } }
       │     c. Allocate WASM memory & execute wasm.seal_request(...)
       │     d. Extract: responseKey (32B), keyId (1B), ephemeralPublic (65B), requestCiphertext (offset 98)
       │
       ├─ 4. POST https://api.wing.st/g (Binary requestCiphertext) ─► Returns 200 with encrypted binary payload
       │
       ├─ 5. Web Crypto AES-256-GCM Decryption:
       │     a. IV = response[0..12] (12 bytes)
       │     b. Ciphertext = response[12..]
       │     c. Additional Data (AAD) = UTF8("lumen-gate-v2") + [0x00, 0x02, keyId] + ephemeralPublic
       │     d. Import responseKey into Web Crypto AES-GCM
       │     e. Decrypt -> JSON text!
       │
       └─ 6. Output Stream Result:
             playlist: "https://lightspeed.st/hls/${stream_uuid}/1/master.m3u8"
             captions: [{ type: "vtt", url: "https://lightspeed.st/hls/.../sub-en.vtt", language: "en" }]
```

### 6.1 Cryptographic Constants & Exact Formulas

```javascript
// Protocol name
const PROTOCOL_ID = "lumen-gate-v2";

// Memory & cipher bounds
const RANDOM_SEED_LEN = 44; // ZW = -1*1511 + 3636 + -2081 = 44
const AES_KEY_LEN = 32;     // g  = 2017 + 8099 - 10084 = 32 bytes (256 bits)
const KEY_ID_LEN = 1;       // _W = 1 byte
const EC_PUBKEY_LEN = 65;   // TW = -6953 + 319*22 = 65 bytes (0x04 uncompressed curve point)
const HEADER_LEN = 98;      // oW = 32 + 1 + 65 = 98 bytes
const GCM_IV_LEN = 12;      // kW = -5092 + 11*464 = 12 bytes
const GCM_TAG_LEN = 16;     // fW = 5789 - 8210 + 2437 = 16 bytes (128-bit authentication tag)
```

### 6.2 Construction of Additional Authenticated Data (AAD)

```javascript
function buildAdditionalData(keyId, ephemeralPublic) {
  const prefix = new TextEncoder().encode("lumen-gate-v2");
  const aad = new Uint8Array(prefix.length + 3 + ephemeralPublic.length);
  aad.set(prefix, 0);
  aad.set([0, 2, keyId], prefix.length);
  aad.set(ephemeralPublic, prefix.length + 3);
  return aad;
}
```

### 6.3 Decryption Execution (Web Crypto Standard)

```javascript
const iv = responseBytes.subarray(0, 12);
const ciphertext = responseBytes.subarray(12);
const aad = buildAdditionalData(keyId, ephemeralPublic);

const subtleKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
  "raw",
  responseKey,
  "AES-GCM",
  false,
  ["decrypt"]
);

const decryptedBuffer = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
  { name: "AES-GCM", iv, additionalData: aad, tagLength: 128 },
  subtleKey,
  ciphertext
);

const payload = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(decryptedBuffer));
// payload.data.stream[0].playlist => master.m3u8 URL!
```

---

## 7. Media Streaming & Playback Mechanics

### 7.1 HLS Master Manifest Architecture
The master playlist served from `lightspeed.st` specifies an adaptive bitrate HLS v7 presentation:
- **Audio Group (`#EXT-X-MEDIA:TYPE=AUDIO`)**:
  - `GROUP-ID="audio"`, `NAME="ENGLISH 5.1"`, `LANGUAGE="en"`, `CHANNELS="2"`
  - URI: `audio-en/playlist.m3u8`
- **Video Renditions (`#EXT-X-STREAM-INF`)**:
  1. **360p**: 640x360 @ 23.976fps | Bandwidth: 853 kbps | Codec: `avc1.4D001E` (H.264 Main L3.0) + AAC
  2. **720p**: 1280x720 @ 23.976fps | Bandwidth: 3.02 Mbps | Codec: `avc1.64001F` (H.264 High L3.1) + AAC
  3. **1080p**: 1920x1080 @ 23.976fps | Bandwidth: 8.12 Mbps | Codec: `avc1.640028` (H.264 High L4.0) + AAC
  4. **4K (2160p)**: 3840x2160 @ 23.976fps | Bandwidth: 23.32 Mbps | Codec: `hvc1.2.4.L153.B0` (HEVC/H.265 Main 10 PQ HDR) + AAC

### 7.2 Steganographic Media Segments (.png)
- Playlist entries declare `#EXT-X-MAP:URI="init.png"` followed by sequential segments `seg-v0.png`, `seg-v1.png`, etc.
- **Binary Inspection**: Magic bytes of `init.png` are `0x00 0x00 0x00 0x1c 0x66 0x74 0x79 0x70` (`....ftyp`).
- **Conclusion**: Segments are **standard fragmented MP4 (fMP4/ISOBMFF)** chunks renamed to `.png` to bypass CDN caching policies and DPI filters. They are completely unencrypted (no `EXT-X-KEY` DRM).

---

## 8. Security Headers, CORS, and LG webOS TV Feasibility

### 8.1 The webOS Origin Challenge

Our empirical network probes revealed a critical security enforcement:
- When requesting any HLS manifest or media segment on `https://lightspeed.st/hls/...`:
  - **With `Origin: https://cinejoy.pk`**: Returns **HTTP 200** with valid manifest/fMP4 data and `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.
  - **With `Origin: file://`**: Returns **HTTP 404 Not Found**!
  - **With `Origin: https://com.cinejoy.tv`**: Returns **HTTP 404 Not Found**!
  - **Without Origin (direct)**: Returns **HTTP 404 Not Found**!
  - **With arbitrary Origin**: Returns **HTTP 404 Not Found**!

### 8.2 Why Direct webOS Client Playback Fails
On LG webOS TV, applications run either from the local package origin `file:///media/developer/apps/usr/palm/applications/com.cinejoy.tv/index.html` or under a registered app URI. Because Chromium strictly enforces the W3C Fetch specification on forbidden request headers, client-side JavaScript (`fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, or `<video>`) **cannot modify the `Origin` header**.
